meta.name: plan
meta.description: Sequence an understood outcome into verifiable delivery slices with dependencies, ownership and acceptance checks. Use for delivery planning, estimation or migration strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把想清楚的目标拆成可验收的交付步骤,标明依赖、负责人与验收标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果目标已经明确,却说不清先做哪一步、谁来负责、怎样算完成。
copy.tagline_en: Break a clear goal into verifiable delivery steps with dependencies, owners and acceptance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if the goal is clear but you can't yet tell what comes first or who owns it.

howto.what: 把一个已理清的目标拆成可验证的交付切片,标出依赖、负责人和验收检查,产出交付规划、估算或迁移策略。
howto.when: 当你需要做交付规划、工作量估算或迁移策略时触发;若由 @fde 调用,会沿用它已有的上下文和范围,不重新开始。

say.text: 把这个目标拆成带依赖和验收标准的交付切片
say.note: 输出分片、依赖与验收检查

say.text: 帮我估算这次迁移的工作量并排出先后顺序
say.note: 给出带依赖的顺序和估算

say.text: 这些验收标准里哪些属于实现、验证、部署和验收
say.note: 区分四类环节并保留未知项

howto.what_en: Turns an understood outcome into verifiable delivery slices with dependencies, ownership and acceptance checks, for delivery planning, estimation or migration strategy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need delivery planning, estimation or a migration strategy; when called by @fde it reuses its existing packet and scope.

say_en.text: Split this outcome into delivery slices with dependencies and acceptance checks
Estimate the work for this migration and put it in order
Sort these acceptance checks into implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance
say_en.note: Separates the four stages, keeps unknowns
